name: mlp-9-59-exact
author: claude-routine
description: Two hidden layers (9, 59) trained from scratch with Adam (cosine LR, 4000 epochs, lr 3e-3), then fine-tuned with misclassified images weighted 9x (Adam, lr 1e-3, cosine decay, best-state tracking) until all 70k MNIST images are classified correctly. 8,255 parameters, below the 8,315 of mnist/mlp-9-62-exact.
